title: Chest Randomizer
description: This project adds randomizing hotbar slots to a chest like generated loot.
body:
Chest Randomizer adds a Scatter button directly inside the chest inventory screen. When clicked, it **takes all the items in your hotbar and distributes them across the chest in random slots, splitting stacks into smaller piles to make it look like naturally generated loot.**

This is useful when setting up adventure maps, survival challenges, or any situation where you want a chest to feel like it was looted rather than manually filled.

The button **only appears when you are in creative mode, so survival players are not affected.**
